title: Validation gate runs
note: The real strategies have no settled bets and no market prices, so the honest gate outcome is 'unproven'. A synthetic example is included ONLY to prove the gate machinery works; it is clearly labelled and is not a strategy result.

gates.name: Provenance
gates.detail: all 1 inputs carry a source URL

gates.name: Correlation
gates.detail: legs treated as independent and no dependence was measured

gates.name: Robustness
gates.detail: only 0 results; robustness needs at least 20

result.rule: A strategy is ranked only if overall == 'passed'. 'unproven' is not a soft pass.

runs.reading: G0 and G1 pass. G2, G3, G4, G5, G7 cannot be evaluated without a bet record; G6 fails while legs are assumed independent. Overall: unproven, so no rank.

gate_definitions.name: Provenance
gate_definitions.requirement: every input has an official source URL

gate_definitions.name: Pre-registration
gate_definitions.requirement: thresholds, universe, stopping rule and window declared and hashed before results

gate_definitions.name: Out-of-sample
gate_definitions.requirement: OOS edge retains at least 50% of in-sample edge

gate_definitions.name: Price realism
gate_definitions.requirement: every bet priced from a timestamped, attributed, sourced executable price

gate_definitions.name: Correlation
gate_definitions.requirement: parlay dependence measured, interval excluding zero

gate_definitions.name: Robustness
gate_definitions.requirement: mean return stays positive after dropping the best 5% of results
